gh issue edit 49 --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

Publish the TypeScript packages after the Blaxel provider lands on `main`. This is the **TypeScript-only** release track (Go tags are [#50](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/issues/50)).

Durable how-to: [`sdks/typescript/README.md`](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/blob/feat/blaxel-provider/sdks/typescript/README.md) → **Manual publish**.

`@sandbox-kit/blaxel` starts at **0.1.0**. Shared packages that gained `Scope.workspace` need a coordinated bump so the registry matches the docs.

## Gate

- [ ] Merge [PR #44](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/pull/44) (`feat/blaxel-provider`) to `main`
- [ ] Cut **only from `main`** after merge (do not publish from the feature branch)

## Why

- Docs already show `npm install @sandbox-kit/sandbox @sandbox-kit/blaxel`
- Registry today: `@sandbox-kit/sandbox` / `@sandbox-kit/contracts` / daytona / modal are **0.1.7** without Blaxel’s `scope.workspace`; `@sandbox-kit/blaxel` is **unpublished**
- Publishing Blaxel alone against old 0.1.7 core would leave workspace config broken for npm consumers

## Steps for this cut

### 1. Preflight (on `main`)

- [ ] `cd sdks/typescript && npm install`
- [ ] `GOWORK=off go run ./tooling/cmd/sandbox-kit test typescript`
- [ ] Dry-run packs (`npm pack --dry-run`) for contracts, sandbox, daytona, modal, blaxel
- [ ] Confirm each tarball has `dist/`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, and versioned deps (no `file:`)

### 2. Version bumps

| Package | Current | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@sandbox-kit/contracts` | 0.1.7 | **0.1.8** |
| `@sandbox-kit/sandbox` | 0.1.7 | **0.1.8** (depends on contracts 0.1.8) |
| `@sandbox-kit/daytona` | 0.1.7 | **0.1.8** (depends on sandbox 0.1.8) |
| `@sandbox-kit/modal` | 0.1.7 | **0.1.8** (depends on sandbox 0.1.8) |
| `@sandbox-kit/blaxel` | unpublished / 0.1.0 on branch | **0.1.0** (depends on sandbox 0.1.8) |

- [ ] Update each `package.json` + workspace `package-lock.json`
- [ ] Point providers at `@sandbox-kit/sandbox@0.1.8`
- [ ] Commit: `Release TypeScript SDK v0.1.8 (Blaxel 0.1.0).`

### 3. Publish order

```sh
cd sdks/typescript
cd contracts && npm publish
cd ../sandbox && npm publish
cd ../providers/daytona && npm publish
cd ../providers/modal && npm publish
cd ../providers/blaxel && npm publish
```

- [ ] Publish contracts → sandbox → daytona → modal → blaxel
- [ ] Verify `npm view @sandbox-kit/{contracts,sandbox,daytona,modal,blaxel} version`
- [ ] Smoke: fresh dir `npm install @sandbox-kit/sandbox@0.1.8 @sandbox-kit/blaxel@0.1.0` and construct `new Client({ provider: blaxel(), scope: { workspace }, … })`

### 4. Docs check

- [ ] Root README / website install snippets work from the registry (not only the checkout)
- [ ] Blaxel provider package version is **0.1.0**, not the shared 0.1.8 line

## Out of scope

- Go module tags / `go get` → [#50](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/issues/50)
- Changing Blaxel API surface; this issue is release mechanics only

## References

- Publish notes: `sdks/typescript/README.md` (Manual publish)
- Prior cut: commit `b8f013d4` (`Release TypeScript SDK v0.1.7`)
- Blaxel package: `sdks/typescript/providers/blaxel`
EOF
)" && gh issue edit 50 --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

Tag and publish the **Go** modules after the Blaxel provider lands on `main`. This is the **Go-only** release track (npm is [#49](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/issues/49)).

Durable how-to: [`sdks/go/README.md`](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/blob/feat/blaxel-provider/sdks/go/README.md) → **Manual release**.

First Blaxel provider tag is **`sdks/go/providers/blaxel/v0.1.0`**. Shared modules that gained `Scope.workspace` need new tags so `go get …@latest` resolves a graph that understands Blaxel client config.

## Gate

- [ ] Merge [PR #44](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/pull/44) (`feat/blaxel-provider`) to `main`
- [ ] Cut **only from `main`** after merge (do not tag from the feature branch)

## Why

- Docs already show:
  - `go get github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/sandbox@latest`
  - `go get github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/providers/blaxel@latest`
- Today there is **no** `sdks/go/providers/blaxel/v*` tag
- Latest shared tags are **`v0.1.5`** (`sandbox`, `internal/sdk`, `internal/contracts`, daytona, modal) — they predate Blaxel / `Scope.workspace`
- Tagging only Blaxel against old `sandbox@v0.1.5` would leave workspace config unavailable on published modules

## Steps for this cut

### 1. Preflight (on `main`)

- [ ] `GOWORK=off go run ./tooling/cmd/sandbox-kit test go`
- [ ] Confirm `go.work.sum` is clean (`sandbox-kit test go` workspace-sum check)
- [ ] Spot-check module paths still build: sandbox, internal/sdk, internal/contracts, blaxel, daytona, modal

### 2. Version / require bumps

| Module | Current latest tag | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sdks/go/internal/contracts` | v0.1.5 | **v0.1.6** |
| `sdks/go/internal/sdk` | v0.1.5 | **v0.1.6** |
| `sdks/go/sandbox` | v0.1.5 | **v0.1.6** |
| `sdks/go/providers/daytona` | v0.1.5 | **v0.1.6** (require sandbox v0.1.6) |
| `sdks/go/providers/modal` | v0.1.5 | **v0.1.6** (require sandbox v0.1.6) |
| `sdks/go/providers/blaxel` | *(none)* | **v0.1.0** (require sandbox v0.1.6) |

- [ ] Update `go.mod` `require` lines (`GOWORK=off go get` + `go mod tidy` per module; refresh examples the same way)
- [ ] Commit require bumps on `main` (or a short release PR) **before** tagging

### 3. Tag order

Annotated tags from the release commit:

```text
sdks/go/internal/contracts/v0.1.6
sdks/go/internal/sdk/v0.1.6
sdks/go/sandbox/v0.1.6
sdks/go/providers/daytona/v0.1.6
sdks/go/providers/modal/v0.1.6
sdks/go/providers/blaxel/v0.1.0
```

- [ ] Push tags to `origin`
- [ ] Verify (allow a few minutes for proxy/sumdb):
  - [ ] `go list -m github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/sandbox@v0.1.6`
  - [ ] `go list -m github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/providers/blaxel@v0.1.0`

### 4. Consumer smoke

In a clean temp module (no `replace`):

```sh
go get github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/sandbox@v0.1.6
go get github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/providers/blaxel@v0.1.0
```

- [ ] Build a tiny program that calls `sandbox.NewClient(blaxel.New(), &sandbox.Config{ Scope: &sandbox.Scope{ Workspace: … }, Region: … })`
- [ ] Confirm docs `go get …@latest` resolves to these tags after the proxy updates
- [ ] pkg.go.dev for Blaxel can lag; optional follow-up

### 5. Docs check

- [ ] Provider / root README Go install commands still match module paths

## Out of scope

- npm / TypeScript publish → [#49](https://github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/issues/49)
- Changing Blaxel Go API surface; this issue is release mechanics only

## References

- Release notes: `sdks/go/README.md` (Manual release)
- Existing tags: `sdks/go/sandbox/v0.1.5`, `…/daytona/v0.1.5`, `…/modal/v0.1.5`
- Blaxel module: `github.com/sandbox-kit/kit/sdks/go/providers/blaxel`
EOF
)" && echo "==== verified ====" && gh issue view 49 --json title,url,body -q '.title + "\n" + .url + "\n---\n" + (.body | .[0:400])' && echo "====" && gh issue view 50 --json title,url,body -q '.title + "\n" + .url + "\n---\n" + (.body | .[0:400])'
